5693.title: ACP maintenance discards calendar-version identifiers
5693.rootCauseOneLine: ACP applies strict SemVer validation to calendar-version identifiers, discarding zero-padded month or day components after executable detection succeeds.
5693.proposedFix: Preserve strict shared SemVer parsing; accept complete calendar-version tokens locally in ACP health and installation version probes.
5693.caveats: Repeated same-agent backend reproduction with real temporary launchers, not a live Cursor or browser run. Reproduction script and exact output are inline in the HTML.
